segments.name: Drug Development
segments.description: Develops extended-release drug-delivery products for post-surgical pain and inflammation, including OcuRing™-K for cataract surgery patients.
segments.evidence: We are dependent on the success of our product candidates including OcuRing™-K.

segments.name: DeepSolar
segments.description: Offers an AI-driven solar analytics software solution targeting utility-scale solar operators, independent power producers, and residential solar users.
segments.evidence: In March 2025, we acquired the business operations related to an AI-driven solar analytics technology, DeepSolar.

changes.text: In March 2025, the company acquired the DeepSolar AI-driven solar analytics business, adding a new line of business.

changes.text: In August 2025, the company acquired a majority equity interest in LayerBio, adding OcuRing™-K to its development portfolio.
